alt: Serving orders one at a time from the front of a line, in the same order they joined, until none remain.

steps.caption: 4 orders wait in line with 'pizza' at the front. Nothing has been served yet.
'pizza' was at the front and is served next. 3 orders remain and 'burger' is now at the front.
'burger' was at the front and is served next. 2 orders remain and 'salad' is now at the front.
'salad' was at the front and is served next. 1 order remains and 'pasta' is now at the front.
'pasta' was at the front and is served next. The line is empty.
1 order waits in line with 'coffee' at the front. Nothing has been served yet.
'coffee' was at the front and is served next. The line is empty.
